question: Do publicly available fund redemptions improve next-quarter stock-return ranking beyond known price history and the four-fund ownership mix?
meaning: Holdings-weighted net redemption rate of the covered holders; not actual forced sales, marketwide ownership or liquidity-normalized pressure
choice_reason: Matched raw price and volume split units not yet qualified; select documented minimum holder-pressure definition BEFORE effects. Liquidity alternative will not be run or selected by results.
fund_scope: Four previously selected surviving named funds, three manager organizations; not representative of all institutions. No outcome-based selection this round.

decisions.filings: latest unique original/amendment with filing date strictly before decision, no same-day ambiguity
decisions.entry: first US trading day after decision, close
decisions.exit: first US trading day after next calendar quarter end, close

universe: All eligible lag holdings meeting preparation screen, without requiring current-end holdings or future quotes. Historical identifiers from same-report-date filings as-of decision. Exact price ticker plus dot/dash formatting only; no merger/rename chaining.
outcome: adj_close exit / adj_close entry - 1, source-reconstructed total return; incomplete/contaminated outcome unknown not zero
features_B: 12-minus-1-month total return using 252 and 21 trading-day lags
feature_note: Dodge fraction is reference; risk, dollar holdings and owner fractions are not industry or market-cap controls. Missing required past history makes predictor unavailable, independent of future outcome.

model_rule.training: expanding prior dates with target exit strictly before current decision
model_rule.features: same-date population mean/std normalization using features only; constant column zero; preserve original alpha values before normalization
model_rule.target: subtract each training-date observed mean return; no target rescaling
model_rule.fit: ridge with penalty 1 on all feature coefficients; no intercept after demeaning
model_rule.selection: no grid, no parameter tuning, no direction flip of raw X after effects
model_rule.objective: sum_date (1/n_date)*sum_i (demeaned_y - standardized_features @ beta)^2 + 1 * sum(beta^2); no further division by number of dates

groups: Rank average ties on full feature-eligible formation set, using (rank-1)/(n-1): lower<=1/3, upper>=2/3. Middle otherwise. Constant score has no upper/lower group. Do not split ties by ticker.
metrics: date-equal-weight Spearman IC, median, positive fraction
upper/lower/whole eligible observed quarterly total returns and upper-minus-whole
same-date/same-evaluation-row B+X-minus-B IC and upper-group observed return difference
four decision cells: selected both, B+X only, B only, neither, counts and observed returns
coverage counts and holding USD, unknown selected outcome fractions by date
descriptive per-date observed group median return and positive-return fraction; no separate efficacy claim
costs: Gross forward group results primary. Illustrative full round-trip deduction 0.20pp and0.50pp scenarios applied equally to every method, not factual cost bounds. Difference unchanged by equal deductions. No annualized account or executable net-return claim with incomplete outcomes.

uncertainty.method: circular moving-block resampling 4 adjacent quarters,2000 draws seed20261023,95% empirical range
uncertainty.applies: IC means, incremental IC, upper-minus-whole and B+X-minus-B upper differences; paired dates
uncertainty.limits: 26 descriptive quarters at most and fewer trained-model quarters; stocks and overlapping managers are dependent; range is exploratory not causal significance

checks: leave-one-quarter-out range and most influential quarter
remove both Fidelity contributions from raw signal while keeping original formation pool; absent remaining covered holdings means unknown not zero; sensitivity only, no retune
known corporate-action/ticker ambiguity exclusions frozen before outcome use
conclusion_bounds: Historical exploration; time-correct does not mean a fresh unseen sample
No minimum economically meaningful effect predetermined; report magnitude and uncertainty, do not claim useful effect excluded solely because significance absent
ETF/A-share/marketwide/causal efficacy not established by US stock results
price_ambiguity_policy: Past price/identity ambiguity makes features unavailable as-of; future corporate-action/ticker/quote ambiguity marks target unknown and preserves formation membership. Never remove formation row using future problems.
feature_timing: last common US trading close ON/BEFORE decision; never feature at next-day entry close
